description: List the service-desk tickets of the one workspace your key is bound to (last 30 days): who they are for, their state, who asked (never a person's id), and how many replies they have. Filter by operator (to), state, origin or your own (mine). Read-only. Needs operators:read.

mine.description: Only tickets you (this key's user) asked.

origin.description: ask: asked by a workspace member in the web app; mcp: filed by an agent key; emitter: filed by an agent or service of the workspace.

to.description: Only tickets addressed to this operator.

name: list_operator_tickets
title: List operator tickets
